metadata.title: Palantir Stock Is Surging Again. A Bullish Upgrade Adds to the Nvidia Momentum.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Palantir Stock Is Surging Again. A Bullish Upgrade Adds to the Nvidia Momentum.
Palantir Technologies stock rose Thursday following an upgrade to Buy as Wall Street believes the stock’s valuation hasn’t been this attractive in some time.
